$comment: openjev-demo catalog. This use case is local-first by design -- a Jev-style decision layer's
whole pitch is fast, cheap, bounded answers from a small local model, not a frontier round
trip -- so control-plane.json's policy admits only 'local/*'. The frontier entry below exists
only because roundhouse's catalog schema refuses to boot with zero models (CatalogError::Empty,
crates/roundhouse-server/src/catalog_config.rs); it is never dispatched to under this use case's
policy, and INFERENCE_API_KEY may be any non-empty placeholder value at boot as a result.
'provider'/'providers' schema note carried over from cache-aware-routing: every model needs a
top-level 'providers' entry (M10.1 provider registry) -- see that use case's README for why.
PRICES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. quality_prior is configuration, not measurement.
local_quality's 0.72 for Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct is the same hand-written placeholder
cache-aware-routing uses (Option B, INTEGRATION.md Gap 4) -- this use case reuses that
use case's already-running, already-validated Dynamo/Qwen worker rather than serving a second
model, precisely to avoid the extra install/GPU-memory cost of standing up Gemma separately.
See README.md 'Why Qwen, not Gemma' for the full reasoning.
